system.description:
Cause a squad below half Cohesion to be forced to make a Rout test. Subtract a number of dice from their roll equal to your Arcane Might. You may instead use this ability when an enemy unit makes a Rout test to subtract dice from that test equal to your Arcane Might.

At Arcane Might IV or greater you may use this ability on a Company or up to ten squads at once if they are not grouped into a Company.
